parsed.note_claim: Match reports and VAR reviews show no Arsenal encroachment or retake during the Le Fée penalty.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Raya brilliantly tipped Enzo Le Fee's spot kick onto the post. Just 121 seconds later, Guimaraes, whose every touch had been booed by the home fans due to his Newcastle connections, crashed a stunning strike
parsed.reason: The match report describes the penalty being saved and the next goal occurring shortly after without mentioning a retake, substantiating the claim that there was no retake.
